title: Anthony Pools v. Sheehan — gravamen
summary: The diving-board dispute illustrates looking at the goods aspect that gives rise to the claim.
notes: Although construction services predominated in the swimming-pool transaction, the complaint concerned the diving board. The book describes application of Article 2 warranty analysis to that goods issue and contrasts it with a whole-transaction predominant-purpose test.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 249–250. Open assigned page 249.
